name: Claude Code Caches
detail: Caches, debug logs, shell snapshots and downloads. Settings and memory are  left untouched.

name: Claude Code npm Cache
detail: The CLI's Node package cache. Refetched when the CLI next updates.

name: Gemini CLI Temp
detail: Scratch files written by the Gemini CLI.

name: Cursor Cache
detail: Cached extension and index data for the Cursor editor.

name: Codex Session History
detail: Recorded Codex sessions and logs. Deleting these loses your past transcripts.

name: Claude Code Session History
detail: Per-project transcripts, backups, and the file history that powers  rewinding edits. Deleting these loses resume, search, and undo.
